description: Rotary Club of Bombay Harbour (RCBH) participated in District Blood Donation weed held from 24th October to 30th October. Two Blood Donation were organIsed by RCBH held on Thursday 29thOctober at Dadar Rly. Station and on Friday 30th October held at Churchgate Railway Station in association with the Blood Centre B.Y.L. Nair Charity Hospital, Mumbai. On 29th October 42 unit collected from Dadar station and on 30th October 60 units from Churchgate Station (total 101 unit collected).
